## Identity and typography

{{< brand logo small >}}

SAMIZDATA researches, writes, and builds data tools for media organisations, NGOs, and other public-benefit organisations.

[This accessible brand link](https://samizdata.co) exercises link color and decoration. **Strong text**, *emphasis*, `inline_code()`, and a keyboard focusable link should remain clear in both modes.
